summary: This short note is a Wikipedia-style entry on Clyde Hart, born 1935, who serves as director of track and field at Baylor University. It also records that Hart retired as head coach of the Baylor track program on June 14, 2005, after 42 years with the program.
one_line: Clyde Hart, born 1935, is Baylor University's director of track and field and retired as its track head coach in 2005.
key_facts: Clyde Hart is the director of track and field at Baylor University.
Clyde Hart retired as head coach for the Baylor track program on June 14, 2005.
Clyde Hart spent 42 years with the Baylor track program before retiring.
